title: Settings
proj.th.send: Send command text to Google Chat
proj.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from the app? The folder is not touched.
acc.keychain: Read the keychain to query quota (sent only to api.anthropic.com, token not stored)
acc.capsNote: Caps are a share of the whole account. Hard: leave at cap − 1, place new lanes at ≤ cap − 3, weekly only; 5h is always soft. A hard account is picked only with data ≤ 10 minutes old.
noti.note: macOS notifies only when you are not looking at that lane/card. Google Chat messages link to the card while remote access is on.
noti.sound: “Beep” on new cards and when a lane is done (key M) · volume
remote.laterText: Remote access over Cloudflare Tunnel, phone pairing and device revoke are not in this version — this tab is view only.
remote.note: When available: every remote request needs a valid Cloudflare Access JWT and a paired-device cookie; remotely you only see this tab and can only switch it off, never on or edit.
engine.uninstallConfirm: Uninstall the engine? Stops the engine and deletes the engine and menu bar plists.
engine.note: Restart: the app loses the connection for a few seconds, then reconnects every lane. Uninstall = stop the engine + delete the engine and menu bar plists ({cmd}); running lanes must be stopped first.
instant: Changes on this tab apply immediately.
proj.d18Note: Every session runs without permission prompts (D18); the engine's block rules still apply.
model.title: Default model
model.sub: Used when nobody picks a model / effort. To switch one session or lane quickly: the model chip in Đang xem.
model.laneNote: unless the orchestrator or the lane's agent picks its own
model.impact: Applies to orchestrator sessions and lanes opened from now on, and to the next restart (account switch, continue) of a session / lane on "Default". A running turn does not change. Never written to {file}.
